questions.stem: What is the LCM of 6 and 8?
questions.solution: The least common multiple of 6 and 8 is 24 because it is the smallest number that both 6 and 8 divide into without a remainder. 12 is a common multiple but not the least, 18 is not divisible by 8, and 36 is a larger common multiple than 24.

questions.stem: What is the LCM of 8, 12 and 16?
questions.solution: The LCM is the product of common and uncommon prime factors. The prime factors of 8 are 2×2×2, of 12 are 2×2×3, and of 16 are 2×2×2×2. Common factors are 2×2, and uncommon factors are 2×3. So LCM = 2×2×2×2×3 = 48. Option 24 is only the common factors, 72 is incorrect as it doesn't include all factors, and 96 is too large.

questions.stem: If the GCD of two numbers is 8 and their LCM is 48, which of the following could be the pair of numbers?
questions.solution: Using the formula: product of numbers = GCD × LCM. So the product of the numbers must be 8 × 48 = 384. The pair 16 and 24 gives 16 × 24 = 384. Option 12 and 32 gives 384 but their GCD is 4, not 8. 24 and 32 gives 768, which is not 384. 32 and 48 gives 1536, which is too large.

hi.stem: यदि दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक 8 है और उनका लघुत्तम समापवर्तक 48 है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी संख्या का युग्म हो सकता है?
hi.solution: सूत्र का उपयोग करके: संख्याओं का गुणनफल = महत्तम समापवर्तक × लघुत्तम समापवर्तक। इसलिए संख्याओं का गुणनफल 8 × 48 = 384 होना चाहिए। युग्म 16 और 24 द्वारा 16 × 24 = 384 प्राप्त होता है। विकल्प 12 और 32 द्वारा 384 प्राप्त होता है लेकिन उनका महत्तम समापवर्तक 4 है, न कि 8। 24 और 32 द्वारा 768 प्राप्त होता है, जो 384 नहीं है। 32 और 48 द्वारा 1536 प्राप्त होता है, जो बहुत बड़ा है।
